values.source_excerpt: find s2_work/tasks/u0322/snapshot -name 'Odometry.msg' -o -type d -name nav_msgs -> no matches; provenance cites a URL (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros2/common_interfaces/4.2.4/nav_msgs/msg/Odometry.msg), not a snapshot/artifact location

notes: msg_type: all three cited locations read as quoted; :122 publishes nav_msgs::msg::Odometry (pkg/Type canonical spelling). QoS: the two nav_msgs/Odometry publishers in the mavros package (global_position.cpp:122 '~/local', local_position.cpp:96 '~/odom') both pass sensor_qos = rclcpp::SensorDataQoS() (:111, :81); the Odometry-related Python helpers (global_position.py:54, local_position.py:81) are subscriptions, not publishers, so the run's 'every publisher in the mavros package' claim holds as scoped. Caveats: mavros_extras contains two further Odometry publishers created with bare depth 10 (wheel_odometry.cpp:199, odom.cpp:82), outside the cited scope; and no rmw/rclcpp QoS headers exist in the snapshot, so best_effort/volatile follow from the SensorDataQoS named profile's library defaults (rmw_qos_profile_sensor_data), which is why qos_basis=default, not literal. definition_id: the provenance is a URL hashed outside the workspace, and no nav_msgs definition file exists in the snapshot, so the definition_hash.py exception cannot apply; the cross-tag equality claim (4.2.3-5.7.0) is likewise network-dependent. Unverifiable.
